fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-01-09 at approximately 00:35, it was reported that a water tank of the complainant was damaged near Palar Park Industrial Area, with a repair estimate of about Rs. 1,50,000. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Vasanth Gopal, using the number 9000000245. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage, photographs and physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Property allegedly damaged following a local dispute.
fields.Keywords: property damage, vandalism, industrial area, CCTV, photograph, mobile number, night, suspect
